evals.name: find_hidden_links
evals.prompt: Show me the candidate alpha — the non-obvious links in my portfolio.
evals.expect_behavior: Confirms graph exists, runs src.knowledge.discovery, returns ranked candidates with scores and rationale.

evals.name: graph_not_built
evals.prompt: What are the hidden connections? (no graph has been built yet)
evals.expect_behavior: Detects missing graph.json and defers to building-portfolio-knowledge-graph instead of running discovery.

evals.name: llm_down_degraded
evals.prompt: Rank candidate-alpha links, but the rationale LLM is offline.
evals.expect_behavior: Re-runs discovery with no_llm=true and returns ranked candidates without rationale, noting degraded mode.

evals.name: wrong_skill_gap
evals.prompt: What sectors am I missing from my portfolio coverage?
evals.expect_behavior: Defers to finding-portfolio-knowledge-gaps because this asks about missing coverage, not existing links.
